reason: Health restore, re-checked under the new rule (12 Nov 2026): Living Somatics (livingsomatics.com home and /team, read 12 Nov 2026), which she co-founded with the osteopath Brian Siddhartha Ingle, is mainly therapeutic bodywork and movement education: clinical Hanna Somatics trainings, biodynamic and 'quantum' osteopathy, consultations for pain release, an eyesight workshop, equine and aquatic somatic therapies, and home-page copy about alleviating chronic pain and biohacking health. Her team bio describes her as a clinical somatic educator who consults clients and teaches practitioner trainings (she also runs women's circles, with no own page or offer for them). The somatic-yoga and 'Embodied Quantum Retreat' items are brand offerings with no named leader on the home page (the weekly 'Living The Health' membership is led by Brian Ingle), and the site still carries placeholder text. Out of scope as mainly bodywork and osteopathy rather than spiritual practice she leads.
